annotations.title: Reply to an open support ticket

description: Send a reply in one of the user's own support tickets — the same thread the dashboard shows, and the same message an agent answers. Closed tickets cannot take replies. Requires the user's confirmation of the exact text.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

message.description: The reply text, written or approved by the user.

ticket.description: The ticket reference (e.g. TK-1A2B3C) or its id, from list_my_tickets.

name: reply_to_ticket
title: Reply to an open support ticket
